title: %max — largest numeric value in an array
purpose: Reduce an array reference to its maximum numeric element.
notes: Folds the whole array; it is not the scalar comparator (that is %maxOf in the numeric family).
A whole-number maximum is emitted as an integer (##); a fractional one stays a number (#).

avoid.why: %max reduces an array; a scalar reference resolves to no array and returns ~ instead of the value
